notes.note: Touk sacrificed his score to tag Neale this week and as a result had just 17 touches at 64%.
Huge game for Touk with 27 handballs to go with 12 kicks and he led the game in clearances with 9. His first over 100 since round 13 and he did it in a big way.
Lots of handballs for Touk with 15 to go with his 9 kicks. This is now two under 80 in a row for him and four under 90 in the last five.
Miller seemed to get a lot of the footy but 18 of his 25 disposals were by hand which meant his score wasn't as high as many thought it may have been.
We didn't know what role Touk would have with the midfield big 3 all playing but he found a way to score and attended just 25% CBAs. Which was the 7th in line for the Suns.
Touk racked up 31 disposals to be one of 7 Suns to hit 100 this week. First back to back over that mark for him since rounds 1 and 2.
Miller racked up 26 disposals as he also picked up some of the disposals that were left on the table by Anderson.
We expected Touk to get the uptick with Petracca out of the side but he was the one that copped the Tholstrup tag but still managed 21 disposals.
With Petracca missing at least 4 weeks we could see Touk get an uptick in possessions and points.
